command: set -euo pipefail; R=/home/andreas/frankenstein-repo; BEFORE=$(git -C "$R" status --porcelain | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); git -C "$R" fetch --quiet origin main; T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/frank-terminal-main-test.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; git -C "$R" archive origin/main scripts/frank_terminal.py tests/test_frank_terminal.py | tar -x -C "$T"; cd "$T"; python3 -m py_compile scripts/frank_terminal.py tests/test_frank_terminal.py; python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_frank_terminal.py; AFTER=$(git -C "$R" status --porcelain | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"; echo WORKTREE_STATUS_HASH_UNCHANGED=$AFTER; echo TESTED_ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse origin/main)
